narrative.intro: Davis Constructors and Engineers has $470M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Davis Constructors and Engineers received 1 award so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $470M. Davis Constructors and Engineers obligations are up 1749239.4% year over year. Historical obligations show intermittent activity: FY21 had $45.6M, FY22 had $702K, FY23 had $3.9M, FY24 had $6.7M, FY25 had $26.9K, and FY26 has $470M. The current-year total is partial, covering fiscal year to date obligations. This profile indicates a large, single-obligation presence in FY26 compared with smaller or sporadic obligations in prior years. Use these figures to assess Davis Constructors and Engineers current federal exposure, absolute scale of FY26 awards, and the contrast with the companys prior fiscal-year obligations.
